description: This PHP source file contains multiple classes related to a Markdown to Confluence content converter, including a test class for table of contents functionality using PHPUnit.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: A simple rendering engine class that returns the 'content' field from data.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Extends an HTML template class to provide a specific engine for rendering.

classes.name: TableOfContentsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the Table of Contents feature in the Markdown converter.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns the 'content' element from the provided data array.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Returns an instance of the Engine class.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Sets up and returns a configuration array with a custom template renderer.

methods.name: testNoTOCByDefault
methods.description: Tests that no Table of Contents macro is added by default.

methods.name: testTOCToken
methods.description: Tests that a [TOC] token is correctly replaced with a Confluence macro.

methods.name: testShouldAddTOCWhenAutoTOCisOn
methods.description: Tests that a macro is added automatically when auto_toc is enabled in the config.

methods.name: testShouldNotAddTOCWhenAutoTOCisOnAndTOCisPresent
methods.description: Tests that a macro is added when auto_toc is enabled, but not re-added if a [TOC] token is already present.
